title: Steam Empire 2
description: This modpack mainly focuses on Create and its addons. It adds machines, automation, factories, transport systems, and many mechanical features to Minecraft. The modpack is all about creativity, building large industrial systems, and making complex automate
body:
This modpack is mainly focused on Create and many different Create addons for Minecraft. It expands the game with mechanical technology, automation, transportation systems, and large industrial-style builds. Players can create complex factories using gears, belts, pipes, trains, and many different machines.

The included Create addons add even more content such as advanced automation, new building blocks, farming systems, storage solutions, decoration, and additional machines. The modpack combines creativity and engineering, allowing players to design huge production lines and detailed industrial worlds while still keeping the classic Minecraft feeling.

The overall experience is focused on building, experimenting, and progressing through automation in an immersive and visually satisfying way.
